scenarios.notes: Could not replay the same crisis with an opposite choice; two games diverge from month 1, so differences cannot be attributed to my choice.

friction.expected: Tapping the text 'Vote for sanctions' picks it
friction.happened: Text tap failed (ok false); page scrolled; had to tap the card by coordinates. Executing without picking silently used the cabinet pick

friction.expected: My sanctions vote explained as passed or failed with its effect
friction.happened: Big FAILED stamp over a UN vote board showing YES 4 NO 12, next to 'You: Vote for sanctions'. Unclear what failed (the vote? Iran's response?). China and Russia 'move against you' also stamped FAILED
Headline card was a staff order, National address, +4 approval; my own vote's effect was buried under Diplomacy
Header 'What your choice did: Your forces gain ground against Iran' although I made no choice that month (staff default)

friction.expected: Same situation again so I can compare
friction.happened: New game opens with a different crisis (Gaza famine); no obvious way to replay my seed or branch from a month

friction.where: Saved games after restarting the title
friction.expected: My month-11 game listed to resume
friction.happened: Only the new month-0 game appeared; first game gone (may be an artefact of the driver clearing browser storage on goto)
Mojtaba Khamenei as Supreme Leader, 'Mokha', IRGC, Abu Dhabi talks: 2025-26 names I did not know; the 'i 2 names' chip and What is going on here helped, but I had to open them
'Score 100 to 100. Approval is pulled down; standing lifts it (12 defence pacts). Heading to 98' is dense but did explain cause and effect; I liked it
Always '1 left' across months; unclear how it is spent or refilled
Buttons are titled with shortcuts (M, N, Ctrl+Enter) but all reachable by tap; fine

suggestions.what: Let me restart the same seed or branch from any past month with a different choice, and show a side by side of the two outcomes
Lead the debrief with the crisis decision I made, with plain cause then effect lines
Explain political capital and show when it is spent
Label the stamp as the order result, not the world's reaction

delight: Score explanation sentence in the debrief gave cause and effect
Era picker globe recolouring and the era blurb in the title
Mission bar moving with numbers (-100 to -51) made progress concrete

fun.reason: Months flow quickly and the art is good, but I mostly accepted staff picks so my agency felt small.

clarity.reason: Debrief gives numbers and reasons, but stamps and headers sometimes mislabel what happened.

visual.reason: Polished scenes, readable on 1366x768 without scrolling hunts.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Monthly crisis and execute loop is clear.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but defaults mean decisions happen without me and the header claims I chose.

realism.reason: Plausible cause chains, but a war ending in month 5 in one run versus dragging on in another, from different openings, made it hard to judge.

replay.reason: I could not rerun the same crisis with another choice, which is my main reason to play.

recommend.reason: Good for a casual what-if; not yet a counterfactual tool.

quit_point: Month 1 of the second Term, when the opening crisis differed from my first game and I found no way to replay my seed or branch; I would stop there as a what-if tester.
verbatim: It looks great and it explains itself well enough, but I wanted to ask 'what if I had voted the other way' and the game would not let me ask.
